slides.texte_overlay:
hidden signs someone wants
to be close to you

they remember tiny details

they bring up something small you said weeks ago. we only remember little details about people we pay close attention to, even without ever meaning to.

they bring up fun topics

people want to stay close to someone who always has something surprising to talk about. interesting stories make people want to stay near you for longer.
slides.texte_sophia:
they bring up fun topics

people always want to keep talking to me now. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a strange myth or a fact, and conversations never run dry.

slides.texte_overlay:
they mirror your movements

they lean in when you lean in and laugh when you laugh. people copy the body language of those they feel connected to, usually without even noticing it.

they find reasons to talk

they ask small questions they could easily answer alone. a little excuse to start a conversation is often a quiet sign that someone wants you near them.

they stay a little longer

when everyone else leaves, they linger for a few more minutes. not wanting a conversation to end is one of the clearest and most honest signs of real interest.
